Black—Victini and Reshiram |prevonum=494 |noevo=incap |pokemonname=Victini |current=With the People of the Vale |java1=[[Nana Mizuki]] }} '''Victini''' (Japanese: '''ビクティニ''' ''Victini'') is a Pokémon who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. ==In the movies== Victini once lived alongside the [[King of the People of the Vale]] in the [[Kingdom of the Vale]]. When war erupted within the kingdom, Victini used its power to super-charge the {{type|Psychic}} Pokémon living in the castle so that the king could move the [[Sword of the Vale]] to a new location. After the king died, Victini remained in the surrounding area, unable to leave due to a barrier created by the Protective Pillars surrounding the castle. [[File:Victini M14 power.png|thumb|left|250px|Victini charging up Ash's Scraggy]] Over the course of thousands of years, a town emerged from around the castle which became known as [[Eindoak Town]]. Victini became known as the guardian of the town, however its existence soon became legend and few people believed Victini even existed. When {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} visit Eindoak Town, Victini transfers some of its power to Ash so he could save some {{p|Deerling}} from falling off a ledge. It later telepathically guided Ash through the tunnels beneath the castle. After Ash found his way back to his friends, Victini secretly stole some of Cilan's homemade {{wp|Macaron}}s just as Ash was about to eat them. It followed the trio during the battle tournament, and even super charged his {{AP|Tepig}} and {{AP|Scraggy}} before coming out of hiding. It later informed Ash that it wanted to escape the barrier so that it could be free to travel the world and see the ocean, and Ash promises to help Victini fulfill its wish. [[File:Victini M14 macaron.png|thumb|250px|Victini eating a macaron]] Later, it is forced into helping [[Damon]] move the Sword of the Vale back to the [[Kingdom of the Vale]]. However, when he realizes this course of action has disrupted the [[Dragon Force]], Victini is freed by {{mov|Reshiram|Reshiram|14}}{{tt|*|Pokémon The Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom}}/{{mov|Zekrom|Zekrom|14}}{{tt|*|Pokémon The Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram}}. The Sword of the Vale absorbs the Dragon Force and is launched into the {{wp|mesosphere}}. The Protective Barriers completely surround Ash in a tight space on the castle. Ash cradles Victini and {{AP|Pikachu}} in his arms, as his body freezes and he slowly runs out of air. Damon appears riding on [[Juanita|his mother's]] {{p|Golurk}} along with Reshiram and Zekrom who try to destroy the pillars, but inevitably fail. Just as Ash loses consciousness, Victini rises into the air and fires {{m|Searing Shot}} at the top of the pillars. This fails to break them, but warms up Ash enough to regain some consciousness. Then, Victini charges up {{m|V-create}} and attacks the pillars, ultimately destroying them, and releasing some of the Dragon Force into space. After the Sword of the Vale is returned to the surface and placed in a new location, Victini returns despite Ash assuming it had given its life, and happily finds itself at the ocean. With the barriers destroyed, Victini is free to go wherever it wants, and it journeys with Ash, Iris, and Cilan for a while before ultimately saying goodbye. ===Personality and characteristics=== Victini has taken a liking to Ash as seen when it powered up his Tepig and Scraggy when they were at a severe disadvantage and Ash was willing to help Victini escape the barriers, holding it. Victini is also shown to be fond of {{an|Cilan}}'s macarons. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|psychic|fire|Victini M14 {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Searing Shot charging|1=Searing Shot|2=V-create}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Searing Shot (Part 1)|1=Searing Shot (Part 2)|2=V-create}}}} {{anmov|Fire|Searing Shot|M14|White—Victini and Zekrom
